U.A. Weekly Timetable.text: A U.A. Academy weekday runs on the chime. Heights Alliance residents cook or grab breakfast in their dorm kitchens and cross the Courtyard to homeroom at 8:30. Mornings belong to standard subjects for every course: English with Present Mic, modern literature with Cementoss, math with Ectoplasm, modern hero art history with Nemuri Kayama, plus each course's own lectures. At the 12:30 bell the whole academy arrives at Lunch Rush's Cafeteria at once; Lunch Rush, the Cook Hero, serves first-rate set meals for about 500 to 800 yen, and the line reaches the doors within minutes. In the afternoon the courses split. Hero Course classes change into costume and board campus buses for Foundational Hero Studies on the training grounds, each class on its own rotation; General Studies keeps lecturing until around four; Support students build in the Development Studio; Management students work through case studies. After classes come the Library, open until nine on weekdays, booked training, clubs, gear fittings and dinner shifts in the dorms, then curfew. Weekends are free, with shorter Library hours, signed-out trips to town and visits home. Recovery Girl's Infirmary keeps class hours and is busiest when training ends. Her rules are fixed: her healing kiss speeds the body's recovery by spending the patient's own stamina, so a drained patient sleeps for hours; she rations it, scolds repeat visitors, sends serious cases to hospital and refuses further treatment, whoever objects, when a patient cannot take more. Exams, events and emergencies override the timetable while they run.
